objective: Win one USD 350 Percona Community article assignment with a narrow PostgreSQL ingestion pitch supported by public MicroQuant code.

source_need.title: Write for the Percona Community
source_need.published_scope: Hands-on articles about Percona tools or the wider open-source database community, including PostgreSQL, migrations, troubleshooting, reliability, batch processing, and useful scripts.
source_need.published_process: Pitch the topic and why the author has done the work; the team replies with feedback, timeline, and editorial direction.
source_need.published_ai_policy: Percona prohibits AI-generated articles, permits AI-assisted drafting, and requires the final article to reflect the author's own implementation, experience, and voice.
source_need.rights: The contributor retains copyright and grants Percona a non-exclusive worldwide publication and promotion license; posts are normally CC BY 4.0 unless otherwise specified.
source_need.policy: A submitted pitch is not editorial acceptance, an assignment, publication, payment, or revenue.

fit.topic: Idempotent OHLC imports with PostgreSQL and asyncpg
supported_now: A composite PostgreSQL primary key over symbol, timeframe, and timestamp
Parameterized asyncpg batch writes using ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE
Freshness queries and an experimental research-dashboard boundary
Public source code and documentation that can support a replay-without-duplicates test
not_claimed: A production incident or production-scale benchmark
Trading performance, financial returns, or customer outcomes
Editorial acceptance, publication, payment, or revenue
fit.claim_boundary: The public code supports a hands-on PostgreSQL design article from an experimental research system. It does not support a production war story or financial claim.

application.method: Official four-field Percona Community form with the maintainer's name, LazyingArt business address, one narrow topic, and one public repository
application.delivery_evidence: The isolated visible browser rendered all four exact fields and one enabled Submit control. One Submit action replaced the form with Percona's confirmation that the submission was received and the team would be in touch; no retry was made.
application.policy: Do not resubmit or follow up before the review date. If accepted, confirm scope, deadline, editorial assistance policy, revisions, invoice details, and payment timing before writing the article.
